navigation.identityError: The identity service is unavailable. Try again after the system credential store is unlocked.
navigation.rotationRuntimePending: Identity rotation was saved, but the running configuration could not be refreshed. Refresh or restart the core before continuing.
navigation.identityRecovery: The identity key is missing or does not match this database. Existing bindings remain preserved; reset creates new node IDs and leaves old bindings orphaned for manual rebinding.
navigation.resetIdentityConfirm: This cannot recover the previous IDs. Existing bindings will remain as orphans, and you will need to choose new targets after nodes are imported again.
navigation.rotateIdentityDescription: Readable nodes move to the new key. Historical bindings that cannot be matched to current definitions remain orphaned.
navigation.rotateIdentityConfirm: Exact matches from the current subscription, proxy providers, and manual nodes will migrate. Historical bindings that cannot be verified remain orphaned for manual rebinding. The old key is retained for recovery.
navigation.pendingRebind: Choose a new target for the previous node {{id}}
navigation.orphanRetentionSummary: {{total}} orphan bindings are retained. {{eligible}} have passed the {{days}}-day retention period.
navigation.purgeExpiredOrphansConfirm: Permanently remove {{count}} orphan bindings that have been missing for at least {{days}} days? They cannot be restored after removal.
navigation.pluginSettingsHint: Permissions and writable fields are listed for review. Runtime settings are saved on each node or chain binding.
navigation.pluginAuditEmpty: No plugin activity has been recorded yet.
navigation.pluginAuditError: Plugin activity could not be loaded.
navigation.pluginSignerRevokeDescription: All plugins from this signer will be disabled. Their bindings are kept, so you can enable the plugins again later.
navigation.pluginUninstallDescription: The plugin files will be removed. Remove its bindings first; a plugin that still has bindings cannot be uninstalled.
navigation.pluginBindingSaveError: Could not save the binding. Check the JSON settings and selected target.

serviceMigration.locationRefusedMessage: The service cannot start the core because its installation path or directory permissions failed a security check. Reinstall the service to restore its files and permissions, then try again. Windows may ask for administrator approval.
serviceMigration.notAutoStartedMessage: The Clash Verge service startup type was changed to Manual or Disabled (often by system optimizer tools), so it no longer starts with Windows; this session is using Sidecar. Reinstall the service to restore automatic startup. Windows may ask for administrator approval.
serviceMigration.title: Service update required
serviceMigration.message: The Clash Verge service version does not match the version required by this app. Choose Reinstall Service to uninstall the existing service and install the required version, or continue with Sidecar for this session.
serviceMigration.checkingMessage: Checking the system service status and current running mode. Please wait…
serviceMigration.unavailableMessage: The required Clash Verge service is not available. Install or repair it, or continue with Sidecar for this session.
serviceMigration.success: The Clash Verge service was updated successfully

errors.stateRefreshFailed: Failed to refresh the service state
errors.revalidationFailed: Failed to refresh the running state

sysproxyPrivilege.title: Could not set the system proxy
sysproxyPrivilege.message: macOS refused the change for lack of privileges. Installing the Clash Verge service lets it make proxy changes as an administrator, and this prompt will not come back.
sysproxyPrivilege.serviceReadyMessage: The Clash Verge service is ready, but the core is still running as a sidecar, which is why setting the system proxy was refused. Switching to service mode fixes it — no reinstall needed.
sysproxyPrivilege.alternative: Alternatively, turn off “require an administrator password to access system-wide settings” in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Advanced.
sysproxyPrivilege.installing: Installing the system service. This may ask for an administrator password.
sysproxyPrivilege.restarting: Service installed. Restarting the core through it…
sysproxyPrivilege.tunTitle: TUN mode needs the system service
sysproxyPrivilege.tunMessage: TUN mode needs the Clash Verge system service to take over network traffic. Once it is installed, TUN mode will be turned on for you.
